TRAIT_TEMPO.text: I can keep up with multiple opponents at once.

TRAIT_DUALWIELDER.text: While wielding two one-hand weapons with at least Journeyman skill on each, I alternate attacks between them. After 4 strikes, I'll attack with both at once. My parry and dodge are reduced by 5% while holding two weapons.
